name: @agents-js/root
description: ACP runtimes over A2A — operator CLI and reusable client library
author: jensbodal

scripts.docs:api: typedoc --options typedoc.config.json && bun scripts/docs-api-postprocess.ts && bunx biome format --write --vcs-enabled=false docs/api/typedoc-sidebar.json
scripts.docs:build: bun run docs:generated && bun run docs:api && bun run docs:index && bun run docs:stories && npx vitepress build docs
scripts.docs:generated: bun run docs:readmes && bun run docs:reference && bun run docs:graph && bun run docs:capability-status && bun run docs:bundle
scripts.docs:generated:check: bun run docs:readmes:check && bun run docs:reference && bun run docs:graph && bun run docs:capability-status && bun run docs:bundle
scripts.docs:dev: bun run docs:generated && bun run docs:api && bun run docs:index && vitepress dev docs --open
scripts.dashboard: bun scripts/dep-graph-gen.ts && bun scripts/test-counts.ts && bun scripts/build-dashboard.ts
scripts.build: vp run -w repo:build && cd packages/cli && bun link
scripts.test: bun scripts/build.ts && bun test --max-concurrency=1 --retry=1 ./tests ./packages ./apps ./docs && bun run test:examples
scripts.test:random: bun scripts/build.ts && bun test --randomize --max-concurrency=1 --retry=1 ./tests ./packages ./apps ./docs && bun run test:examples
scripts.test:examples: bun run --cwd examples/memory-provider-pilot test && bun run --cwd examples/host-memory-pilot test && bun run --cwd examples/renderer-adapter-prototype test && bun run --cwd examples/acp-runtime-smoke test && bun run --cwd examples/hardening-smoke test && bun run --cwd examples/mint-redeem-smoke test && bun run --cwd examples/agui-transport-smoke test && bun run --cwd examples/agents-mcp-smoke test && bun run --cwd examples/registry-sync-smoke test && bun run --cwd examples/ws-bridge-smoke test && bun run --cwd examples/memory-postgres-smoke test && bun run --cwd examples/a2ui-surface-smoke test
scripts.check: bun run release:preflight && bun scripts/validate-build-graph.ts && vp run -w repo:build && bun run --cwd packages/validation generate:acp:check && bun run docs:generated:check && bun run docs:markdown:check && bun run bundle:size:check && bun run typecheck && bunx biome check . --error-on-warnings && bun run check:operator-strings && bun run docs:api && bun run docs:smoke && bun run docs:consistency && bun run test:examples
scripts.typecheck: bunx tsgo --noEmit && bun run --cwd packages/ui-components typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/a2ui-renderer typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/a2ui-host typecheck && bun run typecheck:examples
scripts.typecheck:examples: bun run --cwd examples/memory-provider-pilot typecheck && bun run --cwd examples/host-memory-pilot typecheck && bun run --cwd examples/renderer-adapter-prototype typecheck && bun run --cwd examples/acp-runtime-smoke typecheck && bun run --cwd examples/hardening-smoke typecheck && bun run --cwd examples/mint-redeem-smoke typecheck && bun run --cwd examples/agui-transport-smoke typecheck && bun run --cwd examples/agents-mcp-smoke typecheck && bun run --cwd examples/registry-sync-smoke typecheck && bun run --cwd examples/ws-bridge-smoke typecheck && bun run --cwd examples/memory-postgres-smoke typecheck && bun run --cwd examples/a2ui-surface-smoke typecheck
scripts.clean:dist: bun run clean && rm -rf docs/.vitepress/dist docs/api packages/*/dist apps/*/dist
scripts.clean:all: bun run clean:dist && rm -rf node_modules bun.lockb
